title: WISHES FROM STARS LIMITED-TIME EVENT
lines: 01 WISHES FROM STARS LIMITED-TIME EVENT OPEN
DURATION: December 23, 2025, 05:30 - January 02, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can claim exclusive furniture, materials, furniture parts and other rewards via in-game mail.

CONTENTS: After December 23, 2025, 05:30 (UTC-7), a thank-you letter from Amiya will be sent to all players who have registered and created an account before December 23, 2025, 05:30 (UTC-7) via in-game mail. This mail will expire in 10 days.
02 AMIYA'S BLISSFUL UNIVERSE PACK AVAILABLE FOR A LIMITED TIME
DURATION: December 23, 2025, 05:30 - January 20, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the following pack will be available from the Store for a limited time.
[Amiya's Blissful Universe] (Free)
CONTENTS: Reception Room - Amiya's Blissful Universe Furniture Pack*1, Player - Bunny Record Player*1, Pinboard - 'Dreams Come True' Message Board*1.
03 TEST COLLECTION NEW ARRIVAL AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: December 23, 2025, 05:30 - January 20, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following new outfits will be available at the Outfit Store:
Test Collection - In A Myriad of Universes for Amiya (Guard)
Test Collection - An Airy Dream for Rosmontis
Test Collection - Quiet Move for Zuo Le
During this outfit launch, players who purchase the [In A Myriad of Universes] outfit will receive 'Bunny Wish Star' Icon *1 for free.
04 TEST COLLECTION RE-EDITION AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: December 23, 2025, 05:30 - January 20, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfit will be available at the Outfit Store:
Test Collection - Solo Around The World for Amiya (Medic)
Please stay tuned for more information!
